events.title: NIDARAVE 2026
events.description: Saturday, September 19th, 2026 Trondheim Spektrum -- Hall F Club-Wonderland Events returns to Trondheim Spektrum with NIDARAVE 2026 -- the next evolution of one of the city's most ambitious techno events. After writing a new chapter in 2025, we're back in Hall F for another massive night, pushing the concept even further. This is once again the largest event we've produced since Club-Wonderland began in 1999 -- refined, expanded and driven by the crowd. What to expect? More intensity. More space. More pressure. We're building Trondheim's most immersive techno experience, right in the center of Hall F, with a maximum capacity of 3,000 ravers. Doors open at 20:00. You enter a tight, focused dancefloor that grows with the energy in the room. What starts intimate and raw gradually unfolds into a full-scale rave as the night progresses. LINEUP More info coming soon... ID: 18+ attitude Doors: 20:00 The dancefloor expands as the crowd grows Join the RAVE -- Get your tickets now! NIDARAVE is built by the crowd. By your demand -- we'll expand. So the question remains: how big will it get in 2026? ______________________________________________ Event time/concert start: 20:00 Doors open: 20:00 Age limit: 18 years Duration: 375 minutes Serving: Beer, wine Companion: Free without ticket Access: Wheelchair accessible: Yes Parking available: No Arrangørens nettside Facebook
